headline: 'Father of All Bombs' threat, doctrine shift to asymmetric retaliation, Hormuz economic-leverage warning
dek: Mohebbi: 'The United States has the Mother of All Bombs. We will show them the Father of All Bombs, and it will definitely be something new for them.' No details given.
sources: IRGC spokesperson Hossein Mohebbi, interview with Student News Network (SNN, Iranian state-affiliated)
fault_line: Is this real deterrence that keeps the strike plans off the table — or empty rhetoric that makes a US strike MORE likely?

sections.what_happened: Mohebbi: 'The United States has the Mother of All Bombs. We will show them the Father of All Bombs, and it will definitely be something new for them.' No details given. Also: Iran's doctrine shifts from purely defensive to asymmetric — 'if a country attacks us, we will respond... and we will invade'; retaliation may target any country launching attacks on Iran. On Hormuz: 'The Strait of Hormuz has squeezed the economic and political throat of the United States,' warning of economic/political consequences for Republicans in the midterms. Follows reports Trump considered using the 22,000-lb GBU-43/B MOAB on Pickaxe Mountain.
sections.what_verified: Quote relayed consistently by ANI wire, Economic Times, New Indian Express, Shafaqna Pakistan (via Geo News); Shafaqna carries the doctrine-shift and Hormuz-election lines verbatim from same interview.
sections.what_disputed: No details, evidence, or imagery of any new weapon provided; 'Father of All Bombs' framing echoes earlier Iranian rhetoric (a 2017 IRGC claim; Saddam-era 'mother of all battles'). The weapon itself is UNVERIFIED — only the threat statement is confirmed.
sections.why_matters: Quote-card Short: put Mohebbi's exact words on screen against the NYT post-midterms strike plan — threat vs plan, side by side, with the classification chip on each: his claim is on-record; the weapon is unverified.
